messages:
elaine (marketing): Quick sync — were aiming to publish the 'Optimize: smarter batching' post next Wednesday 09:00 PT. Need changelog link + final docs URL by Monday EOD so we can lock hero copy and webinar slide deck.
raj (eng): On it. Will open the changelog PR today and attach the bench artifacts. PR will include a concise "what changed" + "no breaking changes" bullet.
brooke (docs): Draft public doc exists at https://docs.redwood.ai/optimize-batching-draft. I'll swap to public URL once we get final numbers. Need exact p50 and cost-per-token delta for the hero callout.
mason (product): Rollout plan: small canary first (3% for 20m), then 30% for 40m, then full if green. Feature flag: optimize_batching_v3. Please ensure metric capture for the first two waves.
raj (eng): rollout command for ops:
```
ops/deploy --flag optimize_batching_v3 --waves 3,30,100 --wait 20m
```
raj (eng): uploading bench artifacts to gs://redwood-bench/optimize-batching/v3. Summary in PR: "~18% p50 latency improvement; ~9% token cost reduction" — will refine after final run.
sophie (growth): Webinar planned Thu 10AM PT. If we have a clean bench by Mon, well add a 3-slide bench highlight and a 12s GIF for socials. Can marketing confirm the hero one-liner?
elaine (marketing): Draft hero: "Optimize v3: smarter batching, faster responses, lower cost." Will iterate with the final metric numbers. Also need the canonical changelog link for the release notes and the support KB.
brooke (docs): Once PR is merged, public doc will be https://docs.redwood.ai/optimize-batching. I'll post the final links in this thread and add a short social copy variant.
ops-bot: Canary rollout scheduled for Wed 08:00 PT for flag optimize_batching_v3. CI and smoke tests queued. :gear:
mason (product): reminder: include a rollback snippet in the runbook and an alert channel for early signs of regression (latency > +10% p50).
raj (eng): added rollback command and alert config to the PR, pinging @mason for review. Changelog PR: https://github.com/redwood/infra/pull/980. Will update with final bench pngs by Mon 17:00 PT.
elaine (marketing): great — once brooke posts the live docs + changelog link, I'll finalize the announcement copy and share for a quick round of approvals. Aim to freeze copy Tue noon. :rocket:
